# `cms_part_b_manufacturer_associations`

**Medicare Part B drug manufacturer associations**

Literal HCPCS-to-brand, generic, and manufacturer association rows from the CMS Part B supporting workbook, kept separate from spending totals so manufacturer multiplicity never inflates spending.

**Coverage.** Sampled by design; source coverage is not measured by this schema. Each generation maps one explicitly selected benefit year's CMS Part B supporting Manufacturer Summary worksheet linked to the pinned Part B spending release. Multiple brand, generic, and manufacturer rows can share one HCPCS code, and some skin-substitute or wound-dressing codes carry blank brand, generic, and manufacturer cells in CMS's workbook. No manufacturer spending allocation is reported or inferred. Actual qualification is recorded by the selected generation and retained source evidence. *(measured 2026-11-27)*

- **Parquet file:** `cms_part_b_manufacturer_associations.parquet`
- **MCP `query_sql` support:** Configured; requires an available artifact.
- **Publication status:** Not established by this schema page or its measurement date.
- **Row count:** Not stated here; the MCP `describe_table` reply gives the live count under `publication`.

| Column | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `association_id` | `VARCHAR` | Deterministic sha256 digest of the workbook SHA-256, benefit year, source sheet, and 1-based source row number. |
| `program` | `VARCHAR` | Literal Medicare Part B label; not interchangeable with Part D or Medicaid populations. |
| `benefit_year` | `INTEGER` | Explicit selected benefit year matching the linked cms_part_b_drug_spending release. |
| `hcpcs_code` | `VARCHAR` | Literal Medicare Billing Code (HCPCS Code) linking to cms_part_b_drug_spending.hcpcs_code (many-to-one; never sum spending across a flat join). |
| `drug_description` | `VARCHAR` | Literal Drug Description cell from the Manufacturer Summary worksheet. |
| `brand_name` | `VARCHAR` | Literal Brand Name cell from Manufacturer Summary; blank source cells remain empty strings rather than inferred names. |
| `generic_name` | `VARCHAR` | Literal Generic Name cell from Manufacturer Summary; blank source cells remain empty strings. |
| `manufacturer_name` | `VARCHAR` | Literal Manufacturer cell from Manufacturer Summary, preserving CMS source truncation and blank cells verbatim without expanding or merging names. |
| `spending_allocation_status` | `VARCHAR` | Fixed marker not_allocated_in_source confirming this table carries no manufacturer-level spending share and must not multiply or allocate Part B spending totals. |
| `value_states_json` | `VARCHAR` | Per-column cell state (value, empty, null, or absent) distinguishing blank CMS cells from missing cells. |
| `source_sheet` | `VARCHAR` | Exact worksheet name (Manufacturer Summary) in the retained CMS supporting workbook. |
| `source_row_number` | `INTEGER` | Exact 1-based worksheet row number in Manufacturer Summary. |
| `source_workbook_sha256` | `VARCHAR` | Exact sha256 digest of the retained original CMS Excel workbook bytes. |
| `source_workbook_url` | `VARCHAR` | Official CMS download URL for the supporting workbook from dataset-resources. |
| `source_resources_url` | `VARCHAR` | Exact CMS dataset-resources endpoint matching cms_part_b_drug_spending.source_resources_url. |
| `source_release_logical_id` | `VARCHAR` | Logical identity of the pinned CMS Part B spending source release. |
| `source_release_digest` | `VARCHAR` | Artifact digest of the pinned CMS Part B spending source release. |
| `source_selection_json` | `VARCHAR` | Exact selected release identity, resources manifest digest, workbook resource metadata, headers, and worksheet preamble notes. |
| `source_locator_json` | `VARCHAR` | Exact workbook URL, workbook SHA-256, resources URL/digest, sheet name, 1-based row number, cell coordinates, and observation timestamp. |
| `raw_row_json` | `VARCHAR` | Complete literal worksheet row keyed by exact column header strings. |
